strategy: faithful regeneration from approved full-scene visual reference into flat 2x2 albedo atlas
prompt_used:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production 2048x2048 square albedo texture atlas for four flat decorative surfaces in an actual Blender 3D room.
Input image is the approved visual reference ONLY, not an edit target and not the requested output. Extract the subdued material language from its left back wall tapestry, botanical picture, right forest picture, and quiet woven floor rug. Do NOT output a room or interior.
Output composition: EXACT 2x2 equal square panels covering the complete image, boundaries at exactly x=50% and y=50%. Each quadrant is a complete FLAT FRONT-ON texture filling its quadrant right up to all four edges. No gutters, padding, layout background, outer border, frames, rounded corners, drop shadows, perspective, folded cloth or objects.
UPPER LEFT: dark umber woven tapestry surface, restrained aged brass embroidered crescent moon centered in upper third and a simple fine-line compass/eight-point star motif in middle/lower area, very sparse and muted like the reference left back wall.
UPPER RIGHT: one muted sepia botanical pressed-plant illustration with stem and small leaves on warm aged parchment, no text or labels, delicate hand-drawn organic lines.
LOWER LEFT: desaturated brown/charcoal painting of distant conifer trees on aged parchment, sparse atmospheric forest composition resembling the approved right wall picture. Flat unframed artwork.
LOWER RIGHT: dark rust-brown woven rug texture with subtle narrow antique-gold DOUBLE border inset 8% from this quadrant's own four edges, mostly quiet fiber-textured interior. No fringe, no floor underneath.
Lighting: even neutral diffuse albedo only, retain intrinsic pigment variations but remove directional room illumination, shadows and specular highlights; actual 3D engine supplies lighting.
Preserve the reference palette, aged material, restrained detail and visual role. Four distinct material panels, no added objects, no redesign, no bright colors, purple, blue, letters, digits, writing, logos, UI or watermarks. 2048x2048 PNG square requested.
